title: Beginner pandas: penguin body mass by species

# Load a small biology dataset.
# Goal: practice dropna, groupby, and a simple comparison table.
df = await load_url('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mwaskom/seaborn-data/master/penguins.csv')
print(f'loaded penguins: {df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} columns')
print(df.columns.tolist())

cells.code: compare average body mass across penguin species
cells.html:
Clean missing body mass values, then group by species
clean = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g']) by_species = ( clean.groupby('species', as_index=False) .agg(avg_body_mass_g=('body_mass_g', 'mean'), penguins=('body_mass_g', 'size')) .sort_values('avg_body_mass_g', ascending=False) ) by_species['avg_body_mass_g'] = by_species['avg_body_mass_g'].round(1) show_df(by_species)

Gentoo penguins are much heavier on average in this dataset. This example is useful for teaching dropna, grouping, rounding, and checking how many rows went into each average.
